## Story Handoff
- **Story:** Phase A polyphony→v4E migration script
- **Branch:** `feat/phase-a-migration`
- **From:** Josquin (phase: GREEN, merge agent)
- **To:** Bentham (phase: REVIEW)
- **Status:** TESTS_PASSING — 58/58 unit + E2E pass, `pnpm check` clean, dry-run executed against live polyphony

### PR
**https://github.com/mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web/pull/26** — `feat(migration): Phase A additive migration script`

### What to review

1. **Spec:** `docs/migration/specs/2026-05-19-phase-a-design.md` — original PO-approved design
2. **Plan:** `docs/migration/specs/2026-05-19-phase-a-plan.md` — implementation plan derived from spec (note: plan was amended mid-flight after dry-run surfaced v4E shape mismatches; the divergence doc below codifies the resolution)
3. **Divergence audit:** `docs/migration/v4e-divergence-2026-05-19.md` — Finn's source-of-truth comparison of polyphony db vs v4E `schema.json`. §4.1 (9 new types) and §4.2 (35 prop additions on existing types) are now the authoritative scope.
4. **Implementation:** the PR diff. Two impl commits on top of Tallis's RED commits:
   - `0aaa94d` v4E translator + schema-shape alignment + Phase A scope filter
   - `a73f273` broaden fetchDbState + ESM __dirname fix
5. **Dry-run output:** embedded in the PR body (the full markdown report; 9 wouldCreates + 79 wouldAdds = 44 inline-on-new + 35 on-existing). Cross-check against divergence §4.1 + §4.2 directly.

### TDD compliance
Every GREEN commit follows a RED counterpart on the same branch. Order on the branch:
- 1ec01b4 Tallis Task 1a scaffold (RED-equivalent: dirs only)
- f4b9c52 Tallis Task 2 RED (entu-client) → 38608e0 my GREEN
- a8a9a18 my Task 1b (tsx + scripts; out-of-band, no RED needed)
- 32c4e30 Tallis Task 3 RED → 9f4a501 my GREEN
- 221b286 Tallis Task 4 RED → 87fce67 Tallis fix-up (contract correction) → 22d6076 my GREEN
- 335bbca Tallis Task 5 RED → 0e5f3a6 my GREEN
- fbda3e1 Tallis Task 6 RED → 46bb632 my GREEN
- 2be67a9 Tallis Task 7 RED → 41dd2ad my GREEN
- 0c44830 divergence doc lands
- dac093a / 78bcf1b / 8c4199b / 2766f36 / 8b9293f Tallis amendment REDs (5 modules) + 0220150 E2E count fix
- 8741b71 Tallis phase-a-scope RED → c763433 Tallis count fix-up (35 not 33) → cfa013e team-lead/Tallis divergence doc §4.2 fix → my GREEN bundle `0aaa94d`
- 17efe42 mid-flight divergence doc fix-up
- a73f273 my final GREEN (fetchDbState + ESM)

Every spec inconsistency I hit (4-3 diff/executor contract conflict, 33-vs-35 count, person.voice scope) was surfaced to team-lead BEFORE writing impl code, and Tallis pushed RED amendments to reconcile. No silent contract decisions on my side.

### What to verify particularly
- v4E→Entu field translation (`scripts/migrations/lib/v4e-translator.ts`) — 13 tests cover the named mappings (blurb→label, required→mandatory, sharing→_sharing, inheritsRights→_inheritrights, oauth→string, ref:true→reference, docs-only fields omitted)
- Phase A scope filter (`scripts/migrations/lib/phase-a-scope.ts`) — 35 entries match divergence §4.2 verbatim; 9 tests cover inclusion + exclusion (avatar, voice, display_order, original_*, _inheritrights all excluded)
- fetchDbState query (`scripts/migrations/2026-05-19-phase-a.ts:35-58`) — dropped the `_parent.reference=<db-id>` filter since polyphony's 13 app types are root-level (divergence doc §1)
- Schema-Change trailer convention: this PR does NOT touch v4E schema (it consumes v4E and writes to polyphony's db only) → no `Schema-Change:` trailer needed, no entu/research PR needed
- ESM `__dirname` fix in `phase-a.ts` — runtime-only; tests didn't catch it because they don't exercise `main()`

Looking for your verdict: RED / YELLOW / GREEN. Post on the PR or message back here. After GREEN + PO greenlight, I'll squash-merge locally per common-prompt.md merge procedure, then run live execution (Task 10).

## Story Handoff
- **Story:** Phase A partial-failure recovery — bypass scope filter for §4.1 new types
- **Branch:** `fix/phase-a-partial-failure-recovery`
- **From:** Josquin (phase: GREEN)
- **To:** Bentham (phase: REVIEW)
- **Status:** TESTS_PASSING — 62/62, `pnpm check` clean, dry-run output unchanged from post-merge main

### PR
**https://github.com/mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web/pull/27** — `fix(migration): bypass scope filter for §4.1 new types on partial-failure re-run`

This is the small 3-line bypass you proposed in your PR #26 YELLOW verdict. Implemented exactly as you described:
- `phase-a-scope.ts`: `PHASE_A_NEW_TYPES: Set<string>` (the 9 §4.1 names) + `isPhaseANewType(name)` helper
- `diff.ts`: `bypassScope = isPhaseANewType(typeName)` computed once per existing type; skips `isInPhaseAScope` filter when true

### Diff (4 lines of real change)
- `phase-a-scope.ts`: +14 lines (Set definition + helper function)
- `diff.ts`: import addition + `bypassScope` line + condition change `if (!isInPhaseAScope(...))` → `if (!bypassScope && !isInPhaseAScope(...))`

### Verification
- Tests: 62/62 pass (was 58; Tallis's `e4d70a4` RED adds 4: PHASE_A_NEW_TYPES.size + member assertions, isPhaseANewType true/false, diff partial-failure scenario)
- pnpm check: 0 errors / 0 warnings / 363 files
- Live dry-run against polyphony: identical to post-merge main (9 wouldCreate + 79 wouldAdd + 3 formula deferred) — confirms bypass is silent on a clean db

### TDD compliance
- `e4d70a4` Tallis RED — partial-failure recovery + PHASE_A_NEW_TYPES tests
- `021f1f5` my GREEN — bypass impl

### What to verify particularly
- The bypass condition is `if (!bypassScope && !isInPhaseAScope(...))`, evaluated AFTER the existing-property short-circuit `if (existingProps.has(prop.name)) continue;`. Meaning: still skips props the db already has; still respects scope on existing types; only bypasses scope when a §4.1 type is "in progress" and missing inline props.
- `PHASE_A_NEW_TYPES` is a Set of 9 strings, exported alongside (not replacing) `PHASE_A_PROPERTY_ADDITIONS` and `isInPhaseAScope`. No existing surface changed.
- No v4E schema change → no `Schema-Change:` trailer needed.

Looking for RED/YELLOW/GREEN. Post on the PR or message back. After GREEN + PO Task-10 greenlight, I'll squash-merge per common-prompt.md.
